repo.description:
### Impact

A site administrator can misuse OAuth2 callback path settings to read server secrets, environment variables, and files, and invoke Ruby methods with side effects.

Hosted and multisite installations are impacted where site administrators do not control the server. Exploitation requires a full administrator account. The bundled plugin is disabled by default.

### Patches

The fix limits callback paths to reading token-response data.

Users should upgrade to patched versions.

### Workarounds

Server operators can apply the patch manually or disable the plugin at the deployment level. Turning it off in site settings is insufficient because an administrator can re-enable it.

Discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-QLGMPQRV.
repo.summary: oauth2-basic callback paths call Ruby methods
